message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need to know | |---------|-----------------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to empty your hand in each round. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck works best with 4–8). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two and loses a turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. Turn order moves clockwise unless a “Reverse” card changes direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the color or the number/symbol of the top discard. If you have no playable card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Special Cards** | 1. **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
2. **Reverse** – Changes play direction.
3. **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
4. **Wild** – You choose the new color.
5. **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses a turn. (Can only be played if you have no other playable card; otherwise, the opponent may challenge.) | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you play your second‑to‑last card, you must shout “UNO!” If you forget and another player calls you out before the next player takes their turn, you must draw two penalty cards. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | Add up the point values of the cards left in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards: face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two: 20 points each.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four: 50 points each.
Round winner adds those points to their score. | | **Game End** | First player to reach 500 points (or your chosen target) wins the game. | --- ### Quick Tips - **Keep an eye on the discard pile** – knowing what cards are out can help you anticipate opponents’ moves. - **Use Wild cards strategically** – change the color to suit your hand or to block an opponent. - **Challenge wisely** – if you suspect a “Wild Draw Four” was played illegally, you can challenge. If you’re right, the offending player draws four cards; if you’re wrong, you draw six. - **Plan for “Reverse”** – in a 2‑player game, a Reverse acts like a Skip. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
